categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Canlon Building Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of new building waterproof materials, including waterproof membranes and coatings, as well as providing waterproof engineering construction services. The company serves various sectors such as residential buildings, infrastructure projects like highways, railways, airports, water conservancy, and comprehensive utility tunnels. It also explores emerging markets like industrial roofing, photovoltaic roofing systems, and urban underground waterproofing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced polymer waterproof materials, including TPO and PVC waterproof membranes produced on imported production lines. It has proprietary technologies for MBP polymer self-adhesive membranes and composite steel-plastic panels for roofing systems. R&D emphasizes durability, weather resistance, and environmental compliance, with innovations like non-asphalt self-adhesive membranes and polyurethane waterproof coatings. The company also develops waterproof solutions for specialized applications such as pumped storage power stations and photovoltaic roof systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large real estate developers, infrastructure construction companies, industrial and commercial building owners, and government projects related to urban renewal and underground utilities. The company serves domestic markets extensively and exports products to countries including the US, UK, Norway, Singapore, Australia, and Egypt. It targets both B2B channels through distributors and direct sales to large-scale projects, with growing focus on non-real estate sectors like industrial roofing and renewable energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide sales and distribution network covering major cities and regions. It has manufacturing bases and subsidiaries in provinces such as Jiangsu, Hebei, Hubei, Sichuan, Guangxi, and Jilin. Internationally, it exports to multiple countries across Europe, North America, Asia, and Africa. The company is expanding its footprint in emerging markets and new business areas within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Canlon operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying waterproof building materials. It sources raw materials like asphalt and HDPE particles from petrochemical downstream suppliers and delivers finished products to construction companies and distributors. The company also provides downstream waterproof engineering services, integrating product supply with installation and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in polymer waterproof materials, aiming to enhance product performance and environmental sustainability aligned with China's dual carbon goals. R&D focuses on developing differentiated products such as high-performance composite panels and self-adhesive membranes with superior durability. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to accelerate technology transfer and expand applications into industrial roofing, photovoltaic systems, and underground waterproofing. The strategic plan includes diversifying into new markets and improving cost efficiency through advanced manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of waterproof materials including membranes and coatings, and waterproof engineering construction services. The company employs a mixed sales model with a majority through distributors and a portion via direct sales to large real estate and infrastructure clients. It also earns income from exports and other business activities such as material sales, hotel operations, and property leasing, though these are minor contributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading player in China's polymer waterproof materials industry, recognized for its technological innovation and brand strength. It competes with numerous small and medium enterprises in a fragmented market characterized by overcapacity and quality variability. Jiangsu Canlon differentiates itself through advanced product certifications, comprehensive R&D, and a broad sales network. The industry is consolidating, with the company aiming to expand market share by focusing on quality, innovation, and green transformation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.38 billion, a 15% decline from the previous year, primarily due to reduced real estate sector demand. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 538 million, impacted by revenue decline and significant impairment provisions. Total assets stood at about RMB 5.08 billion, with equity of RMB 1.78 billion. The company is undergoing strategic transformation to reduce reliance on real estate and improve profitability, with ongoing investments in new business areas and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Canlon emphasizes high-quality, durable, and environmentally friendly polymer waterproof materials with superior performance characteristics such as dimensional stability, weather resistance, and adhesion. Its proprietary technologies and certifications (CE, BBA, FM, SGS) underpin product reliability. The company offers integrated waterproofing solutions including innovative composite panels and photovoltaic roofing systems, providing customers with long lifecycle value and reduced maintenance costs. Its extensive distribution network and technical support enhance customer service and market reach.
